technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with RSI and stochastic bullish crosses offset by weak trend structure, price below key moving averages, and low ADX—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: COST shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk 105 days out.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (381.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals; earnings 105 days out provides buffer but overall environment highly unfavourable for equities.
